housing.summary: Numbeo reports a monthly average of SAR 4,428.68 for a one-bedroom apartment in Riyadh city centre. The official Ejar deposit page says a contract may be documented with no deposit; when one is specified, Ejar registers and holds the amount, so no fixed month norm is stated (https://www.ejar.sa/en/page/181067).

banking.summary: Riyad Bank lists the current-account documents for non-Saudis as an Iqama, a clear postal address, and an additional postal address in the home country.
required_docs: Additional postal address in home country

schools.summary: The Riyadh international-schools directory lists American, British, IB, and French curriculum schools.

legal_admin.summary: After arrival, the residence-registration step is issuance of the resident identity (Iqama) through Absher; the official service covers a family member or domestic worker registered to the beneficiary.
legal_admin.registration_step: Issue the resident identity (Iqama) through Absher after the person is registered to the beneficiary.

tax_finance.summary: For a newcomer conducting business that is subject to Saudi income tax, registration of the establishment with the Ministry of Commerce generates a TIN; the taxpayer then completes registration in the ZATCA e-portal. The source does not establish a standalone TIN process for an ordinary non-business newcomer.

transport.summary: Riyadh Public Transport provides integrated Riyadh Metro and Riyadh Bus services; its official ticket page lists a regular 30-day pass for SAR 140. For public-health appointment access, the Ministry of Health instructs users to download Sehhaty, register their data, and have an Absher account (https://www.moh.gov.sa/en/eservices/sehhaty/pages/appointment-booking-on-sehhaty.aspx).
transport.network_name: Riyadh Public Transport (Riyadh Metro and Riyadh Bus)
transport.healthcare_registration: Download Sehhaty, register your data, and use it to book primary-healthcare appointments; an Absher account is required (https://www.moh.gov.sa/en/eservices/sehhaty/pages/appointment-booking-on-sehhaty.aspx).
